answer: Beacon spot-checks stop fake identities. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities at random and demands a compute pulse in ten minutes: a small puzzle tied to its key. Miss twice and the 50 POA deposit is forfeited. A raven on the vine spots grafted branches: a forger with 1,000 fakes must answer 50 checks per epoch, burning 100 POA of compute and risking 50,000 POA in deposits, while an honest agent pays one 2 POA check and keeps its reward.
